title: The virus Albert Wesker hid in the first Resident Evil
subject: wesker
description:
Did you suspect Wesker survived the mansion? 👇

The prototype virus that brought Albert Wesker back after the Tyrant attack. Spoilers for Resident Evil and Resident Evil 5.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: A Tyrant drove its claw through Albert Wesker's chest in 1998.
It happened in the lab under the Spencer Mansion, right after he woke the creature himself.
The surviving S.T.A.R.S. members watched him fall.
Before that night, his old partner William Birkin had given him a prototype virus, and Wesker had injected it.
His body rebuilt itself before the mansion exploded. He came back faster and stronger, eyes glowing red behind the sunglasses.
Eleven years later, in Resident Evil 5, he told Chris Redfield, "Seven minutes is all I can spare to play with you," and meant it.
